scenes.text: Most people miss this Wisconsin auto question.

scenes.question: Uninsured motorist coverage in Wisconsin is:
scenes.explain: UM is mandatory in WI: 25/50, bodily injury only. UIM is the optional one.

scenes.label: Wisconsin liability minimum
scenes.caption: $25K per person, $50K per accident, $10K property damage.
